newsitem.title: SPAIN: Yield fall to save Spain 150 bln pta in 97 - Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Yield fall to save Spain 150 bln pta in 97 - Folgado.

text.p: Spanish Economy minister Jose Folgado said on Wednesday that the fall in market yields from last September will save Spain around 150 billion pesetas in 1997 on a national account basis.
"In comparison with the calculations we did in September 1996 (when the budget was prepared), we can have a saving of around 150 billion pesetas," Folgado told reporters.
He added that on a cash basis Spain is spending more than the previous year in interest expenditure.
In the first quarter alone, this item rose 24.4 percent to 1,079.3 billion pesetas, but he added that, due to a specific trend of the interest payments, this rate is expected to fall to two percent.
